About MyTimeline.in
We're a small, fast-moving team (1–10 people) building the next generation of intelligent, agentic applications. At MyTimeline.in, we don't just ship features—we ship autonomous systems that think, reason, and act on behalf of users. We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer who can bridge robust MERN architecture with cutting-edge AI agent workflows.
The Role
You'll own the end-to-end development of AI-powered features across our platform—building autonomous agents that interact with users, process complex workflows, and integrate seamlessly into production MERN stacks. This isn't a "bolt-on AI" role. You'll architect systems where LLMs, vector memory, and tool-calling agents are first-class citizens of the stack.
What You'll Do
Architect and build scalable backend services in Node.js/Express with MongoDB, designing schemas and APIs that support agent memory, context windows, and multi-turn reasoning
Develop autonomous AI agent workflows using LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and custom tool-calling architectures
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant) to ground agent responses in real-time data
Build reactive, performant frontends in React/Next.js with TypeScript, including real-time agent interaction UIs (streaming responses, tool execution visualizers, agent state monitors)
Design agent memory systems—short-term (Redis/cache) and long-term (vector DB + MongoDB hybrid stores)—for persistent, contextual agent behavior
Integrate WebSockets/SSE for real-time streaming between agents and users
Deploy and monitor containerized services (Docker, AWS/GCP) with a focus on LLM latency, token economics, and fault tolerance
Collaborate directly with founders to translate ambiguous AI product ideas into shipped, production-grade features
Must-Haves
2+ years of production experience with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)
Solid understanding of asynchronous JavaScript/TypeScript, REST/GraphQL API design, and NoSQL data modeling
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) beyond basic prompt engineering
Familiarity with at least one AI orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agent loops)
Experience with vector databases and embedding strategies for semantic search or RAG
Comfort with Git, CI/CD, and cloud deployment basics (AWS, GCP, or Vercel/Railway)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote-first, early-stage environment
Nice-to-Have
Experience with agent frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen
Background in fine-tuning or deploying open-source models (Llama, Mistral) via Ollama, vLLM, or HuggingFace
Familiarity with multi-agent systems, planning algorithms (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve), or tool-use patterns
DevOps experience: Kubernetes, Terraform, or advanced AWS architecture
Open-source contributions or side projects in the AI/LLM space
Previous startup experience—you've shipped 0→1 products before
